name: 표현) 나 이제 늙었나봐/ 너도 내 나이 돼봐

keywords.ko: Getting old sucks.(늙는 거 진짜 싫다.)
→ sucks는 일상적인 대화나 캐쥬얼한 대화에서 자연스럽게 사용.
I’m getting too old for this. (이런거 하기엔 이제 너무 늙었다 → 육체적,신기술에 대해 이해하거나)
I’m feeling my age. ( 나이가 든 것이 느껴진다/ 실감된다.)
요즘 확 늙은 기분이야 I’m feeling my age these days.

keywords.en: B: Yeah. I’m feeling my age.
When you get to my age, you’ll know all about it.
When you’ve lived as long as I have, you’ll know all about it.
I’m not as young as I used to be.

When you get to my age, you’ll know all about it.

my_sentences.en: I’m getting too old for understanding slangs.
I visit my university where I graduated and meet some peope. I was feeling my age. I couldn’t communicate with them.
When you get to my age, you’ll know all about it. Quit slowly
